# Source format instructions

TypeScript (`.ts` and `.tsx`), JavaScript (`.js`), Go (`.go`), Java (`.java`), C (`.c`), C++ (`.cpp`), CSS (`.css`), HTML (`.html`), shell (`.sh`), Python (`.py`), Markdown (`.md`), JSON (`.json`), TOML (`.toml`), YAML (`.yaml` or `.yml`), and Rust (`.rs`) are source or format markers, not paths.
Use `*.py` when documenting a glob rather than a concrete file.
A neighboring concrete reference, `docs/missing.md`, must still be validated.
